subject: Visit timing
text:
Running a little late with this, but I need to lock in a visit sometime this week. My current calendar is thin on Wednesday after noon and open Friday before one, so either of those windows could work if your team can squeeze me in. The unfinished task on my side is the client summary; it is mostly assembled, but the budget table still needs one more pass because the latest numbers changed after I had already started formatting. That means I can visit, but I should not bring the final file yet. I would still like to walk through the site, take measurements, and confirm the access notes so I can finish the summary accurately.

If Wednesday works, I can arrive around one and leave by three. If that collapses, Friday morning is also fine, though I would need a short buffer because the summary may run late if the updated figures arrive from the finance thread. I can bring a laptop, a tape measure, and the draft pages, but I am not sure whether the meeting room has a projector. Also, do I need a visitor badge or just sign in at the desk? I will keep this visit tight, but I would rather ask now than wander around the lobby waiting for someone to notice me. If you can reply before Thursday noon, I can book the train ticket while the earlier fares are still live. I appreciate you sorting this quickly if you can also, please.
